top_signals.title: Robert Kaplan: Fed Can Wait Before Hiking Rates
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Vice Chairman and former Dallas Fed chief Robert Kaplan says the central bank can afford to hold off on raising rates by one meeting while continuing to assess economic indicators. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: U.S.-brokered truce appears to hold in Ukrainian town close to starvation
top_signals.summary: The local truce, brokered with the involvement of Pope Leo, is intended to allow aid into Oleshky and enable those who want to leave to do so.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Discord is making public chats searchable on Google: How to opt out
top_signals.summary: Discord conversations on large public servers will soon reach audiences far beyond their communities, raising privacy concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cruise strands passengers in Cambodia after fuel surge
top_signals.summary: The luxury cruise company suspended operations, citing "extraordinary" fuel costs.
